title: Point-Slope Form
text: The start and end of the line give us $$2$$ points that we can plug into slope-intercept form: $$y2-y1=m \left(t2-t1\right)$$.

title: Solve for $$m$$.
text: We now have $$450-150=m \left(25-15\right)$$. Simplify and isolate $$m$$.

title: Slope-Intercept Form
text: Since we have $$2$$ points and a slope, we can solve for the y-intercept: $$150=30\times15+b$$.

title: Interpret y-intercept
text: $$y-intercept=-300$$ means that at $$t=0$$, i.e. $$0$$ years since $$1980$$ (which means in 1980), the company had $$-300$$ thousand dollars in profit.
